covers.title: Rapid quenching by ram-pressure stripping in a young cluster at $z = 1.7$

assertions.text: The stripping radius now carries a propagated confidence interval, the comparison sample has been re-derived on a matched stellar-mass calibration, and the quenching timescale claimed in the abstract is now derived in the Results rather than asserted.
The revised manuscript remains under consideration at Nature Astronomy alone.
The authors continue to declare no competing interests.
